title: Pipping-Gamon et al. (arXiv:2604.01491v2) Ridge Bradley-Terry Pass Protection & Disruption Rating
summary: Joint opponent-adjusted ridge Bradley-Terry early pass-rush win (<=2.5s) and multinomial full-play {loss,win,pressure,sack} model with OLS EPA disruption weights (win=0.009, pressure=0.103, sack=1.0). Reduces held-out Weeks 16-18 log-loss by 4.5% (early) and 3.6% (final) vs smoothed matchup baselines and achieves 0.915 All-Pro rusher AUC.

title: Yurko, Nguyen & Pelechrinis (arXiv:2406.17220v2) NFL Ghosts Counterfactual Defender EPV
summary: Uses 500-tree RFCDE for YAC conditional density integrated against Expected Points g(Y) and 2D spatial ghost defender distribution h(l|X_{-def1}) with distance-weighted 3D trajectory resampling (B=100) across 10,363 passes to isolate nearest-defender positioning EPV value added (r=0.65 vs YAC allowed).

title: Nguyen & Yurko (arXiv:2603.17866v3) Bayesian Multilevel Step-and-Turn Generative Movement
summary: Generative tracking framework decomposing 10 Hz movement into Gaussian scaled-arcsine step length with RB/defense random effects and von Mises turn angle with step-length-conditioned log concentration (log kappa = gamma0 + gamma1*s + w_j) for posterior predictive hypothetical rollout valuation.

title: Szekely et al. (arXiv:2303.05774v1) Scouting Combine Predicts Matriculation Not Career Snaps
summary: Across n=805 complete 2013-2017 Combine profiles, tuned Random Forest predicts >=1 NFL snap at 83% test accuracy (0.81 CV; 3-cone and 40-yd top features), whereas best career-snap regression achieves R^2=0.17 (RMSE=1,210.1 CV) -> Combine constrains entry viability priors only, not snap-count projection weights.

title: Yang, Ge & Cui (J. Big Data 2025 12:91) Calibration & Transition Quality Findings [CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 Cite-Only]
summary: Non-derivative methodological citation: deep spatial/event classifiers require explicit ECE calibration checks, Permutation Feature Importance should preserve structural graph edges, and transition quality/timing/pressure context outweighs raw transition volume.

title: 2026 PFR Punting 32-Team Field Position Snapshot & Causal PBP Cross-Audit
summary: Parsed all 32 NFL teams from PFR 2026 Punting (avg 47.5 Y/P, 42.1 NY/P, 40.1% In20%, 7.0% TB%). Top NY/P: LV 44.6, DEN 44.2, WAS 44.2, GB 44.0, JAX 43.8; Bottom: TB 38.4, ARI 39.2. Research/audit only; causal runtime projections remain strictly on cleared nflverse PBP week < as_of_week.
